supersedes: Historical CKAN_ physical-name proposal in this manifest's Git history; no native migration was performed
approach: SharePoint native Lists and Libraries core first; configuration before code; no bespoke SPFx or CKAN runtime
canonicalIds: UUID strings independent of SharePoint IDs, filenames, paths and source module identities

sourceAuthority.approvals: External CareOps/organisation governing systems; catalogue reference only
sourceAuthority.security: Actual SharePoint permissions, not metadata display status
sourceAuthority.organisations: Reuse authorised existing organisation taxonomy/list; optional new list after gap analysis

libraries.name: Catalogue_Assets
libraries.purpose: file bytes/versions; metadata projection and publication artefacts
libraries.permissions: provision only in an approved classification/retention boundary; split libraries/sites for different access classes

sharedSiteColumns.name: CAT_DataStage
sharedSiteColumns.note: logical provenance/curation stage, not security level

sharedSiteColumns.name: CAT_ContentSHA256
sharedSiteColumns.note: trusted hash captured through approved workflow, not automatically computed by SharePoint

core.gate: approved test site, exact readback, index/permission validation, fictional fixture and recoverable deployment

commissioningRules.idAssignment: Select and test an approved UUID assignment mechanism before native intake is accepted. A unique Text column does not generate or validate UUIDs. A documented steward-assisted create path or minimal standard-connector assignment flow may be used; incomplete intake remains restricted and unverified.
commissioningRules.identityPreservation: Allocate once; reject duplicates; preserve IDs through rename, move, version restore and export/import. Do not replace IDs during no-op provisioning or infer identity from a filename.
commissioningRules.resourceBinding: A verified resource must reference an existing DatasetID and exactly one AssetID or ExternalResourceURI. A report/dictionary/protocol can use either location. The file asset must exist and its CAT_DatasetID/CAT_ResourceID must match; no orphan may be advertised as verified.
commissioningRules.validationBoundary: Required/unique columns, defaults and views are not cross-list transactions, UUID validation or field-level authorization. Qualify native controls and a steward check or narrowly scoped standard flow. Do not add a custom app solely to validate this manifest.
commissioningRules.privilegedFields: Before readers are admitted, evidence owner and permissions for changing IDs, classification, review/release status and links. Form hiding/formatting is not security. Default to steward-managed edits; any broader intake must not be able to self-approve or widen access.
commissioningRules.noDefaultPublication: Do not default CAT_DataStage to platinum or populate CAT_ReleaseReference without a verified publication decision. approved-public is classification metadata, not anonymous-sharing permission or evidence of publication.
commissioningRules.fileSafety: Initially restrict the library to the approved steward/test audience. Test direct upload and bulk edit as well as forms. Files with incomplete metadata remain in that boundary; moving to another access class requires independent permission verification.
commissioningRules.bindingRegistry: Resolve each domain AssetID to a private physical site/library/file identity and exact version. Use current permission-checked resource URLs, not paths as durable identity. Domain exports omit credentials and bearer/signed sharing links.
commissioningRules.recovery: Use expected-version checks for helper writes; reject stale updates rather than overwrite. Test partial provisioning and partial upload/metadata failure. Rollback must not delete user-created records/files or widen access; use an explicit deployment inventory and recovery receipt.
commissioningRules.viewEvidence: View names are design placeholders. Before provision, define target object, internal field names, indexed filter/sort and expected fixtures. Assets - Published requires independently checked release evidence; ReviewStatus or data stage alone is insufficient.
commissioningRules.coreAdmission: M1 ends only after native create/find/edit/link/deny/withdraw/restore and UUID-preserving export/import pass with optional modules absent. A source-only merge or unavailable native permission is not successful commissioning.

optionalAfterCore.gate: multiple datasets require source-target provenance edges
approved publication requires independent manifest records
multiple external approvals need structured many-to-many links
term set/choice insufficient for clinically versioned mappings
security, retention, restore or lifecycle require physical segmentation
native views fail faceted discovery requirements and approved app catalogue exists

manifestKind: design inventory, not executable provisioning or JSON Schema
